title: Kernel connecting map constructed from a projective resolution
statement: For a commutative ring R, modules M,F,N, and a surjective q:F → N, construct δ_q : Tor₁(N,M) → ker(q) tensor M, using Tor from [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Choose Mathlib's projective resolution P of N and lift its augmentation ε:P₀ → N through q to e:P₀ → F by projectivity. The composite e d₁ factors through ker(q); tensor it with M and restrict to cycles in degree one. It kills boundaries because d₁d₂=0, so descend along the cokernel presentation of H₁. Precompose with P.isoLeftDerivedObj to obtain torKernelBoundary. No witness of an unproved existence theorem supplies any data.
